title: Stop deriving packets-timing expected vectors from production timing code
description: P2 test-oracle integrity: packets_timing_vectors() imports production airtime, Trickle, DAO, CSMA, SFN, time-sync, DIO/IPv6/ICMP/SCHC/frame and other helpers, executes them, and publishes their return values as canonical expected JSON. Tests and --check can therefore self-confirm regressions by regenerating the oracle from the same implementation under test. Convert normative outputs to literal/spec-formula reference calculations isolated from lichen.*, add fixed external KATs for security wire material, and have separate tests compare production to those immutable values.
